### Checked in code
Web: every file under web/src/components/contour that carries semantics; shell (RouteFocus, SkipLink, ShellMain, AppHeader, AccountMenu, CommandPalette, ShortcutsDialog, ErrorView, LoadFailure, global-error); MapFrame and SitePlan markers; ZoneEditor, Handles, ZoneList, PointsTable; DataScreen, DataTable, DataMap; CoverageIsland; UploadStep file input; auth forms; shortcut layer; global CSS and tokens.

Native: ui primitives (Button, IconButton, Text, TextInput, AnswerTile, RadioRows, Checkbox, Switch, Segmented, ModeStrip, TabDock, ListRow, ScreenHeader, Screen, Note, StatusLine, Field, ProgressBar, Skeleton, OnlineIndicator, PasswordInput, NumberStepper, Avatar); collect (CollectScreen, PlaceStep, QuestionStep, ReviewStep, SavedStep, CollectMap, pin); sign-in; account; legacy records.tsx and chrome.tsx; the preferences code path.

### Can only be established at runtime
RouteFocus behaviour with loading.tsx; actual VoiceOver, TalkBack and NVDA speech for live regions and step transitions; TalkBack handling of tooltipText (A11Y-08); native reading order on tablet landscape with hand-left; Android duplicate "tab"; dock clearance at 200 percent text; hardware-keyboard focus visibility on native; 320 px and text-spacing reflow of fixed-height controls; axe in open overlays and the editor; forced-colors.

### Compatibility code that contradicts the no-legacy policy
`mobile/src/ui/OnlineIndicator.tsx:11-31` (`loadNetInfo` try/require plus `unavailable`) tolerates \"a development build made before it was added\". It is defeated anyway because `mobile/src/sync/provider.tsx:1` imports NetInfo statically. Delete it and import `useNetInfo` directly.

### Contrast method
Ran WCAG relative luminance over every foreground token against every surface token in both themes, then the used pairs in both map palettes and the legacy Nocturne palette. tokens:check's pair list is hand-enumerated, which is its real limitation, but no combination that is actually used fails today. Opacity-reduced text exists only on disabled controls (exempt). Map overlays and aerial imagery sit outside the tokens contract and need a rendered check.

Confirmed: observations/index.tsx:4-6 Redirect to /records, and records.tsx is registered as a root route in app/_layout.tsx. The records.tsx refs are exact: :57 arrow labels, :62 title is a plain Text with no header role, :88-130 ungrouped row, :109 Chip, :115 numberOfLines={2}. chrome.tsx:157, :220-250 (Chip is text-only, textStyles.micro) and :492 are exact, and theme.ts:85 micro is 11.5/17. I recomputed the Nocturne contrast pairs: minimum 6.08:1 (footer), chips 7.49 to 9.52, so the no-contrast-failure claim holds. can_delete is correct: theme.ts is imported only by records, chrome, screen, screen-message and session-banner; screen-message is used by auth/provider.tsx; session-banner is used only by the legacy Screen. results.correction: Core claim stands: the Observations tab is the legacy Nocturne screen, with no header role on the title, an 11.5 pt text-only chip with no glyph, and a numberOfLines={2} clamp that breaks DESIGN Rule 05. Corrections: (1) A record is 4 accessible stops (OBS label, chip, meta, summary); the 5th (sync_error) appears only on rows that have an error. (2) The 'no max font multiplier' point cuts the other way. Legacy Text has no cap, so it scales fully with the OS font size, while Contour Text caps at 1.8 to 2.0x. At AX3 the chip scales well past 14 pt, so the verification step 'state word at least 14 pt at AX3' already passes. The real issues are the default 11.5 pt size, the dark Nocturne theme in sun (DESIGN Rule 06), and the clamp. 'Hardest to read with large text' is overstated. (3) The clamp hides only the observer's free-text answer summary. The state word and sync_error are never truncated, so 'is my record safe?' is still answerable. (4) 'The one screen' is overstated: the Contour Account screen (account/index.tsx:104-126) already shows per-state counts with StateBadge. Only the per-record list is legacy. (5) The arrow being read aloud is plausible but not device-verified. (6) The fix is already tracked: MOB-27 (mobile/PLAN.md:524-540, status doing) item 1 is the Observations list and item 7 deletes theme.ts, chrome.tsx and the records route. result.summary:
The suites are better than their wiring. Where tests exist they are mostly real: web unit tests import the actual modules and distinguish failure, stale, offline, conflict (412/409/428/429/401) and DST cases; mobile store, outbox and session tests run real SQL (node:sqlite) with fakes only at the network edge; the zone e2e specs exercise two-actor, offline, sign-out-in-another-tab and account-swap journeys. The problem is reach, not quality.

CI runs 84 of 477 web node tests. The 393-test unit suite (2 s) is not run, nor is forms:parity (the only thing tying web's copy of the form engine to the cases that test it) or tokens:check, while docs say CI runs "the same checks". The one test that drives the real collector upload code against the real API has a Python driver that no script, CI job or pytest path invokes; the other four acceptance files skip silently. There is no native runner (MOB-21 is still todo) and mobile component tests render a hand-written fake react-native, so kill-and-relaunch, device upload and the collect screens (CollectScreen, CollectMap, QuestionStep) have no runtime coverage. The schema-reset test asserts that unsent records are wiped; nothing asserts a guard.

The browser suite is cheaper than feared (about 2 min per project for the scan, measured from artifact timestamps), but its "honesty" scan is a copy and layout lint on one seeded success state, screenshots.spec is an asset generator running in five projects, and a handful of tests mirror other tests or pin unreachable compat. Fixes are small: three CI lines, one named command, about ten deletions, four to six new tests. No new framework except Maestro, which the plan already names.

findings.current_behavior: The behaviour is deliberate pre-launch policy and the test proves the wipe is transactional. justified_choices: Store, outbox and session tests run real SQL through node:sqlite behind a thin LocalDatabase adapter and fake only the network edge (mobile/src/storage/package-store.fixture.ts, sync/coordinator.test.ts): this is why lost-response replay, account fences at token/response/queued-write phases and 27-record drains are trustworthy.

Language-neutral contract cases (contracts/forms/definition.cases.json, forms/cases/*.cases.json, zones/geometry.cases.json) are consumed by web, mobile and backend, so one authored expectation guards three implementations.

Web unit tests use node:test with --experimental-strip-types and a 40-line resolve hook (tests/unit/support.mjs): no transpiler, 393 tests in about 2 s, and they execute real src modules rather than copies.

Web unit tests distinguish the states the product promises: 401 pause, 403/404 no access, 412/409/428 conflicts, 429 Retry-After, offline then confirm-on-reconnect, server echo mismatch, unreadable sources not reported as fine, DST fall-back days, counts exact vs capped.

The zone e2e specs (zones-conflict, zones-account, zones-network, zones-publish) test the actual interrupted-work paths against the real API: two managers, sign-out in a second tab, account swap sending nothing for 12 s, offline edit saved on reconnect with a leave guard, lost answer replayed once.

The specimen suite exercises keyboard, mouse and touch geometry editing, lossless serialisation, no tile requests and axe while drawing without needing sign-in or an API; gate 8 attaches frame timings instead of asserting a flaky threshold.
screen.fixture reads controls by accessibility label and text as a screen reader would, and the fixture header states honestly that layout is not computed.

Playwright is configured conservatively: workers 1, retries 0, forbidOnly in CI, loopback-only baseURL guard, and the seed refuses hosted or credential-bearing targets with tests in CI (database/seed-web-workspace.test.mjs, scripts/e2e-local-seed.test.mjs).
tsc includes e2e/*.ts and playwright configs (tsconfig include **/*.ts), eslint covers tests, and biome plus tsc cover mobile tests, so spec code cannot rot at type level.
The service-worker test runs the shipped source in node:vm with fake caches and asserts private URLs, RSC requests and no-store responses are never cached.

keep_despite_complex.why: Pointer, touch and keyboard geometry editing cannot be covered by unit tests, and the config needs no stack.

The full Playwright suite was not run for this audit; only a 14-test sign-in run (perf/stackA-e2e-local.log) and Oct 13 artifact mtimes (web/e2e/screenshots, assets/screenshots/web/raw) were available, so functional e2e wall time and flakiness are unmeasured.

web/e2e/.auth/*, .env files, mobile/credentials and database/.local were not opened.
backend/tests (93 files) and database/tests/*.sql were not assessed for quality, only for whether CI reaches them and which driver scripts call them.
No physical device or simulator was driven; native behaviour (expo-sqlite kill semantics, MapLibre, SecureStore) is inferred from sources and fakes.
Whether any current web page swallows a failed read into an empty list was not exhaustively traced (TEST-05 is a missing guard, not a confirmed violation).
Bundle, render and API performance were out of this dimension (other auditors own them).
result.assessment_markdown:
## Test groups: what each protects, how real it is, verdict

Counts: web node tests 477 (84 run in CI, 393 not); web Playwright about 425 executions per full run; mobile vitest 839 tests (834 pass, 5 acceptance skipped) in 5.2 s; scripts and database node tests 10 (in CI).

| Group | Files | Protects | Real vs mocked | Verdict | Justification |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| CI-gated web tests | web/tests/api-errors, auth, profile-answer, data-export (84 tests) | open-redirect safeNext, identity schema, service-worker private-URL exclusion, API error copy, export columns | real modules; SW source run in node:vm with fake caches and fetch | KEEP | The only web tests CI runs. Loop-generated cases are cheap. Drop the legacy cache-name expectation (auth.test.mjs:66) with the legacy names. |
| Zone editor logic | tests/unit zone-save-queue, zone-drafts, zone-editor-state, zone-drawing, zone-geometry, zone-plan, zone-hints, zone-identity, zone-publish, zones-page, zone-editor-chrome | lost or duplicated saves; 412, 409, 428, 429, 401, 403, offline, echo mismatch; shared geometry cases | real source plus contracts/zones/geometry.cases.json, no mocks | KEEP, add to CI | Best state coverage in the repo (loading, failure, stale, offline all distinguished). zone-editor-chrome's hex-literal source scan is a lint in test clothing and re-implements WCAG luminance: MERGE the helper (TEST-08). |
| Manager data truth | data-view, data-map, summary, reports, overview, export-files, api-shapes, answers, time, labels, site-view, site-code | exact counts vs the 500-row cap, project-timezone days across DST, unread sources not reported as fine, answers labelled by form version | real source, janet JSON contracts; hand-written .mjs fixtures, not type-checked | KEEP, add to CI | Protects what a manager reads as truth. labels.test.mjs REWRITE (regex over mobile source); remove null round_type cases (TEST-07). |
| Access, identity, org, team | access, home, workspace-index, org, team-rules, invitation, invitations, project-settings-rules, account-deletion, ids, errors | role gating, home routing, invitation links, deletion states | real | KEEP, add to CI | ids (2) and invitations (4) are near-trivial but free. |

## Step 7. Keyboard and accessibility

### 7a. Tab order and dialogs (`j7a-keyboard.json`, `j7a-invite-focus-restore.json`)

Focus-indicator detection compares a pixel diff of the element focused and unfocused.

- **Sign-in:** Email is auto-focused. Tab then goes Password, "Show password", "Sign in", "Forgot password?", "Create account". All show a visible indicator (3 px solid dark outline in Day).
- **App shell and /data:** the first stop is the link "Skip to content", and Enter moves focus to `<main>`. The 42 stops are brand, Organization, Project, Search, Account, the 8 project tabs, then page controls: Copy link, Export, Site, Round type, Observer, From (4 stops), To (4 stops), Search, a table row, Refresh, 6 map markers, then Zoom in, Zoom out and Map layers. Indicators are visible except on 3 of the 6 markers. The markers sit on the same point in this seed, so one marker's focus ring is covered by the others.
- **After client navigation:** focus lands on `<main id="main">`, and the title updates ("Sites · DECA Mark").
- **Account menu:** Enter opens it. ArrowDown walks Account, Project settings, Day, Dusk, Keyboard shortcuts, Sign out. Escape returns focus to the "Account, Local manager" button.
- **Edit site details dialog:** it opens on the Name field and focus stays inside over 10 Tab presses. Escape closes it and focus returns to "Edit details".
- **Invite dialog:**
  - It opens on the radio "Observer" and is named "Invite someone to Play study acceptance". Focus stays inside, the background is hidden, and Escape closes it.
  - After closing, focus is left on `<body>` in 6 of 6 trials instead of returning to the Invite button. I tried keyboard and mouse opens, and Escape and Cancel closes.
- **Zone draft editor:** 35 stops with indicators visible on all. The zone list is a listbox: one Tab stop, ArrowDown moves between zones.

### 7b. axe (`j7b-axe.json`, `j7b-axe-by-rule.json`)

- **Setup:** @axe-core/playwright 4.13.0 (axe-core 4.13.0) with tags wcag2a, wcag2aa, wcag21a, wcag21aa and wcag22aa.

## Step 8. prefers-reduced-motion (`j8-reduced-motion.json`)

The stylesheet has a blanket `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` rule (`app/globals.css:172`) that sets animation and transition duration to 0.01 ms !important and scroll-behavior to auto.

- **No-preference:** 8-11 elements have transitions (max 240 ms; tab links 0.2 s, buttons 0.12 s). The menu pop-in runs 200 ms, the dialog fade 120 ms plus pop 200 ms, and map zoom shows 10 distinct intermediate marker positions.
- **Reduce:** `matchMedia` is true and the computed `transition-duration` is 1e-05 s on every element sampled (button, tab link, account trigger, search pill, select, island). No element has a transition above 0.02 ms, menu and dialog do not animate, and map zoom jumps in one frame. Transitions do not animate under reduce.
- **Unused token:** the `--ct-duration-reduced-fade` (100 ms) token exists but is never used, because the blanket rule makes reduce fully instant.

## Consolidated findings (my severity labels)

| # | Finding | Step | Severity |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | A save after session expiry shows a generic crash page, loses the form, and says nothing about the session or whether the save happened | 3b | High |
| 2 | One outage gives two outcomes: a shell-less LoadFailure titled "organization" on fresh load, but a "Something went wrong" boundary on client navigation | 3a | Medium |
| 3 | Root font-size is ignored by text (px tokens). At 320 px with 200% root two pages overflow sideways, island content is clipped and controls cover the map | 7c | Medium |
| 4 | The Invite dialog never returns focus to its trigger (6 of 6) | 7a | Medium |
| 5 | Observer direct entry to /forms issues getProject, listSites and listForms before the observer screen | 3c | Low-Medium |
| 6 | Editor save status stays "Checking whether your last change was saved…" for 6 s in a real outage and 40 s in an emulated PUT failure | 3a | Low-Medium |
| 7 | `fm-place` survives sign-out with the last project path. `sb-127-auth-token` is JS-readable with about 400-day expiry (standard @supabase/ssr) | 4 | Low |
| 8 | Role and org are not visible in the header below 1024 px, and the observer sees "MEMBER" | 1 | Low |
| 9 | Org no-access pages have no h1. The sign-in page gives no signed-out reason. Signed-in users can open /sign-in | 3b, 3c, 4 | Low |
| 10 | Multi-word search matches any word | 5 | Low |
| 11 | The success toast overlaps content | 6 | Low |
| 12 | The local DB is behind repo migrations, so Forms and Data degrade (environment, not the app) | caveat 1 | Env |

Strengths:
- 0 axe violations in 60 runs.
- No horizontal overflow in 88 measurements.
- No cross-identity content leak via Back, direct URL or caches.
- The service worker caches public assets only.
- Filters, deep links and copied links round-trip.
- Double submit sends one request.
- A mutation propagates to detail, list, overview and filter without reload.
- The zone editor guards unsaved changes.
- Skip link and route focus work.
- Keyboard routes exist for the map content.
- Reduced motion stops all animation.
